sample.selection: fixed arithmetic progressions; train begins at known reset anomaly 104; no score-dependent selection
sample.provenance: all sequences previously exposed by exhaustive s03/s15/s21/s26; not an independent holdout

fixed_procedure.features: 12 representatives i{0,1}_{p0,p11,dp0,v0,v11,dv0}, plus a0..a7; raw non-sentinel values and sentinel indicators; no IDs, flags, targets or quantum
fixed_procedure.anchor_detector: current a6 < -5.19; row 0 initialized; no future minimum
fixed_procedure.fit: weighted ridge on clipped targets, train rows>=99 and need_prediction, deterministic stride 8 of eligible rows; train mean/scale; regularization 0.001 times target total training weight; intercept unpenalized
fixed_procedure.metric: pooled valid rows>=99 and is_scored; targets and predictions clipped [-2,2], weight abs(clipped target), separate correlations averaged
fixed_procedure.bounds: one rowgroup at a time; feature arrays under 100 MB; one CPU; 2 GiB; no GPU
fixed_procedure.controls: same fitted rowwise ridge carried at true a6 anchors, price-change anchors, and five causal delayed-anchor streams; each true reset queues one reset delayed uniformly 1..7 rows, FIFO at least one row apart; seeds 7300+rowgroup+100000*replicate; terminal pending events can reduce count; first delayed stream also trained separately as an input-distribution control
fixed_procedure.uncertainty: per-sequence paired descriptive differences and sequence resampling only; connected components unavailable, no campaign-valid confidence interval

tests.hypothesis: constant labels make current-input revision unnecessary within a6 intervals
tests.comparison: same fitted rowwise predictor: current versus true-anchor carried predictions; separate anchor-trained ridge checks distribution shift
tests.matched_control: same predictor carried at price anchors and five causal randomized-delay anchors with matched event count up to right censoring; separately trained first delayed-anchor model
tests.rejection: current predictor beats true-anchor carry by >0.01 mean WP and wins on >60% of evaluable sequences; this rejects hard persistence for this probe, not all models
tests.inference: current/past input features and cached predictions only

tests.hypothesis: fixed a6 threshold catches every target change without whole-sequence minimum
tests.comparison: count threshold misses and extras; contrast target changes missed by price anchors
tests.matched_control: price-change anchor detector using current/previous inputs
tests.rejection: one target transition missed by fixed threshold refutes exact sufficiency
tests.inference: current a6 and previous input state; targets used solely for offline audit

notes: No score-dependent tuning; any follow-up must be recorded separately before scoring. No claim of baseline improvement or independent confirmation.
